notes.title: Thanks for stopping by!
notes.content:
We're so excited you decided to stop by the TENSE community page. We're thrilled to partner with you to make this game the best it can be. We're a team of fewer than 10 people who have been working on this game, so we really appreciate your support.
Come hang out with us on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/VWE9AGt877]https://discord.gg/VWE9AGt877[/url].
